momentum_themes.detail: Electronic technology names dominating momentum leaderboard with storage/semiconductor plays showing massive acceleration. INTC up 83% vs 21W leading broader chip recovery.

sector_analysis.headline: Energy Minerals Leading, Health Tech Lagging

strongest.note: Perfect bullish score with all 14 energy stocks in Full Bull structure.
Broad-based strength across industrial service providers benefiting from infrastructure spending.
Manufacturing renaissance continuing with 14 of 18 names showing bullish structure.

weakest.note: Biotech/pharma sector showing widespread weakness with 15 of 21 names bearish.
All commercial service names showing bearish structure in sector rotation away from services.
Software sector under pressure despite individual standouts like PANW and CRWD showing reversal potential.

sector_analysis.detail: Clear rotation from growth/tech services into cyclical value with energy, industrials, and materials leading while healthcare and software lag significantly.

news_drivers.headline: What Moved Markets
news_drivers.summary: U.S.-Iran geopolitical tensions dominated headlines but failed to derail risk assets, with markets focusing on big tech earnings strength. Healthcare cost pressures and energy infrastructure disruptions provided sector-specific headwinds and tailwinds respectively.

items.text: Iran-U.S. tensions and Strait of Hormuz concerns boosted energy sector leadership while weighing on broader sentiment
Big tech earnings vindicated AI spending thesis, supporting electronic technology momentum despite software sector weakness
Healthcare cost surge narrative pressured biotech/pharma names, contributing to sector's -57% net bearish score
UAE air traffic normalization signals easing Middle East disruption fears for transportation sector
